subject.title: fix(channels): clarify message receipt delivery evidence

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new public `channel-outbound` receipt-evidence helper/type now, or keep receipt semantics docs-only until a broader verified-delivery contract is designed?
rationale: This PR is technically plausible, but publishing a new Plugin SDK helper becomes a release contract and overlaps the broader open verified-delivery semantics design.

options.title: Close for now
options.body: Close this PR and invite a maintainer-sponsored, rebased API proposal if the receipt-evidence contract is wanted later.

options.title: Sponsor the API
options.body: A maintainer can approve the API shape, then require a rebase, regenerated baseline, docs, and focused validation before merge.

options.title: Ask for docs only
options.body: Request a narrow docs-only clarification that `MessageReceipt` means platform send acceptance, without adding a new public helper/type.

recommendation.title: Close for now
recommendation.body: Close this PR and invite a maintainer-sponsored, rebased API proposal if the receipt-evidence contract is wanted later.

likelyOwner.reason: The channel message lifecycle SDK and current receipt/channel-outbound surfaces trace most strongly to steipete in local and GitHub history.
